## 11. Issues Summary

### A. Dead / Obsolete Files to Delete

1. `backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/V1__create_shared_files.sql` — old PostgreSQL DDL; Flyway not in pom.xml; never runs
2. `FINAL-REPORT.md` — internal agent artifact with hardcoded absolute paths
3. `e2e/TEST-SUMMARY.md` — internal agent artifact
4. `test-report.html` — internal agent artifact, hardcoded port 8080
5. All `.agents/tasks/*.txt`, `*.json`, `*.py`, `*.ps1` (except this cleanup plan and FEAT artifacts) — agent work files

### B. Generated Artifacts in Source Control

6. `backend/src/main/resources/static/` — generated frontend bundle; should be in `.gitignore` or excluded via `.gitignore`
7. `e2e/test-results/` — screenshot/test output files (already in `e2e/.gitignore` but present on disk)

### C. Port 8080 Inconsistencies (Real port is 8787)

8. `README.md` — 13+ occurrences of port 8080 throughout docs and examples
9. `docker-compose.yml` — exposes `8080:8080`, references `APP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080`
10. `backend/Dockerfile` — `EXPOSE 8080` (should be `EXPOSE 8787`)
11. `frontend/nginx.conf` — `proxy_pass http://backend:8080` (wrong in Docker context)
12. `e2e/tests/07-security.spec.ts` — hardcoded `port: 8080` in raw HTTP request
13. `e2e/tests/demo-live.spec.ts` — `const API_URL = 'http://localhost:8080'`
14. `e2e/demo/live-demo.ts` — `const API_URL = 'http://localhost:8080'`
15. `.env.example` — references old `DATABASE_URL/USERNAME/PASSWORD` (PostgreSQL removed!)

### D. Dead Code in Production Source

16. `AppProperties.java` — `baseUrl` field: bound from `app.base-url` in YAML but never read by any service at runtime (NetworkService replaced it). The field should be removed along with the YAML key.
17. `TokenUtil.java` — `hashToken()` method: never called in production code (only tested). Either remove it or document it as an extension point.
18. `NetworkService.java` — `getShareBaseUrl()` (no-args overload): never called; only `getShareBaseUrl(int port)` is used. Dead method.
19. `FileMetadataResponse.java` — `qrCode` field: never populated by `mapToMetadataResponse()` in `FileShareService` — always `null`. Misleading.

### E. Stale `.env.example`

20. References `DATABASE_URL`, `DATABASE_USERNAME`, `DATABASE_PASSWORD` — PostgreSQL removed from the project; these should be removed.
21. `FILE_STORAGE_PATH=./temp-files` — wrong default; actual default is `./storage/files`.

### F. E2E Test Issues

22. `03-file-upload.spec.ts` — asserts `shareUrl` matches `/api/files/share/` but actual shareUrl uses `/share/` (SPA route). This test will fail.
23. `07-security.spec.ts` — raw HTTP request hardcodes `port: 8080` — will fail against port 8787 backend.
24. Tests `01`, `02`, `03`, `10`, `11` — read from `.agents/tasks/services-status.json` at module load time (outside any test function). This makes them fragile and agent-dependent; should be replaced with env-var-based URLs.
25. `demo-live.spec.ts` — `const API_URL = 'http://localhost:8080'` hardcoded. Will fail.

### G. Docker Configuration Issues

26. `docker-compose.yml` — still references PostgreSQL (`postgres` service) which was removed from the application. The compose file should be updated to just `backend` + `frontend` services.

### H. .gitignore Missing Entries

27. `backend/src/main/resources/static/` — generated by `start-lan.ps1`, should be git-ignored
28. `e2e/package-lock.json` — lock file (frontend's is git-ignored but e2e's is committed)
29. `test-report.html` — generated HTML artifact
30. `.agents/tasks/*.txt`, `.agents/tasks/*.json` (except planning artifacts)

### I. frontend package.json — Unused Dependency

31. `"qrcode": "^1.5.3"` and `"@types/qrcode": "^1.5.5"` — never imported in any source file. QR generation is done server-side (ZXing). These can be removed.

### J. Documentation Inaccuracies in README.md

32. Quick Start section says backend starts at `http://localhost:8080` — should be `8787`
33. Architecture diagram shows `:8080` — should be `:8787`
34. Docker table shows backend at port 8080, swagger at :8080 — should be :8787
35. LAN Mode section references `8080` and `3000` — should be `8787`
36. Project structure shows `model/` directory — does not exist; model POJOs are in `storage/`
37. API reference shows `"shareUrl": "http://localhost:8080/api/files/share/..."` — should be `/share/` (SPA route), port 8787

### K. Unused Imports / Minor Issues

38. `frontend/src/main.tsx` — imports `React` but uses `React.StrictMode` (valid), no issue
39. `ShareController.java` — imports `FileStorageService` (used directly for loading resource in `streamFile`); valid
40. `FileShareService.java` — `getFileByToken()` is not called by any controller. It's a dead public method.
